instructions:
Solo audio-DSP project (music remix prep). Prioritize silent correctness bugs over style.

1. Unit mismatches: seconds vs samples vs librosa frames vs milliseconds across function boundaries.
2. Raw vs normalized scales (onset envelopes, thresholds).
3. Channel layout: librosa (channels, samples) vs soundfile (samples, channels).
4. Hardcoded sample rates / window sizes that should scale with sr.
5. Dropped PCM_24 subtype or implicit resampling on writes.
6. Suspicious edits to tests/benchmark/baseline.json without a matching detection improvement.

Do NOT comment on print-based logging, missing type hints, missing docstrings, or security hardening. Light touch on musicbot/web/frontend/**.

files.description: Project-specific review guidelines for audio DSP pitfalls

rules.rule: Flag any comparison of a raw-scale threshold against a librosa-normalized [0,1] envelope (or the reverse).
baseline.json is a quality ratchet — never loosen floors without an accompanying algorithm improvement in the same PR.
